title: Blocking or unblocking SSE-C for a general purpose bucket
note: Q1 LW fix (Amendment 3): starting April 2026, S3 automatically disables SSE-C for all new general purpose buckets and for existing buckets in accounts with no SSE-C encrypted objects; a blocked PutObject/CopyObject/Multipart request specifying SSE-C is rejected with HTTP 403 AccessDenied unless the bucket's PutBucketEncryption configuration explicitly re-enables SSE-C.
